text: `desktop-file-validate data/io.github.sureserverman.AppImageControl.desktop` passes, and on the VM live session `sh /tmp/aic-vm.sh 'python3 scripts/atspi-smoke.py activation'` exits 0. That mode installs the service file into the test user's `~/.local/share/dbus-1/services/` with `Exec` set to the built binary, makes sure no instance runs, calls `gdbus call --session --dest io.github.sureserverman.AppImageControl --object-path /io/github/sureserverman/AppImageControl --method org.freedesktop.Application.ActivateAction show-updates [] {}`, then asserts via AT-SPI that a window appears with the "Updates" toggle checked
why: VM live-session D-Bus + AT-SPI test; prove-claim must not run on the VM. Host: desktop-file-validate data/io.github.sureserverman.AppImageControl.desktop exit 0. RED before the fix: activation smoke FAIL 'ActivateAction show-updates failed: ...Spawn.ChildExited ... exited with status 1' (binary printed unknown option '--gapplication-service'). Manual mutant on the VM: win.show-updates without toggle.set_active(true) -> FAIL: the 'Updates' filter is on; restored -> PASS (window appears, Updates on, open window switches back from All, one main window, no CRITICAL).
